join hortbot 999 foobar 1


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add repeatme Hello there! (_MESSAGE_COUNT_)
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' added, restricted to subscribers and above.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme 30
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' will now repeat every 30 seconds if at least 1 message has passed.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :hey
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 10s
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 22s
sleep 100ms
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hello there! 3

checkpoint
clock_forward 30s
sleep 100ms
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat off repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Repeated command 'repeatme' is now disabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :hey
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 31s
sleep 100ms
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat on repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Repeated command 'repeatme' is now enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :hey
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 31s
sleep 100ms
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hello there! 7


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat delete repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' will no longer repeat.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :hey
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 31s
sleep 100ms
no_send
